claim: loss halt and drawdown budget cut the worst outcomes

data.process: GARCH(1,1)-t(4) 4-hour returns with a 30-day -1%/day regime; U(0,1) target weights

metric: 99th percentile max drawdown; median terminal wealth (start 1.0)

treatment.arm: RiskEngine: 5% daily halt + 20% drawdown kill switch

effect.what: p99 max drawdown, limits minus none

verdict_rule: supports if p99 drawdown (limits) - p99 drawdown (none) < -2 SE (paired bootstrap)
summary: p99 max drawdown 25% with limits vs 70% without (diff SE 1.8%); median terminal wealth 0.879 vs 0.797 (diff +0.082, SE 0.009); kill switch tripped on 96% of paths
